approved_scope.title: Install musl-tools in CI through a fallback Ubuntu mirror when the runner's mirror does not resolve
approved_scope.description: Install musl-tools in CI through a fallback Ubuntu mirror when the runner's mirror does not resolve
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: CI infrastructure only: the musl release-baseline jobs keep building and checking the same archives (REQ-github-025 unchanged); only how the runner obtains musl-tools changes, so no canonical spec or requirement changes
acceptance_criteria: The ci.yml musl install step runs .github/scripts/install-musl-tools.sh and keeps its per-target env exports unchanged; with a stubbed apt-get whose runner mirror does not resolve, the script installs musl-tools through the fallback mirror list on the x86_64 mirror-list, arm64 ports and one-line sources layouts, leaves third-party sources alone, passes Acquire::Retries and Timeout to every apt-get call, and ends in ::error:: when every mirror fails or no Ubuntu source can be repointed; validate-action and the fledge musl-install-test task run that test
